messages:
sam: deploy-bot blocked rc-2.3.0 canary — SBOM vuln scan reported a medium severity vuln in transitive dep `libproto 2.1.3` (CVE-2026-1234). change window ends in 2h. can we get quick triage?

deploy-bot: [automation] SBOM scan result for release/rc-2.3.0: 1 medium - libproto@2.1.3 (transitive). Action: HOLD per policy 'transitive-medium'. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/1978123456

judy: @sam thanks for the ping. quick question — is the vulnerable path used in the hot path (inference runtime) or only build-time tooling?

sam: runtime path via `model-convert` step, but only for non-hosted private deploys. Hosted API builds don't include it. impact to canary: minimal RT, but possible data-plane crash if triggered.

mike: TL;DR we need to decide pin vs rollback vs exception. change window closes at 17:00 PT. if we wait for a patch we miss the window.

nina: QA reproduced the crash with a crafted payload using the converter binary. not widespread but deterministic. attaching repro snippet.\

```
# repro (run locally in isolated env)
./converter --input test.pb --exploit
# crash -> stacktrace: libproto!deserialize+0x42
```

judy: given reproducible crash, my inclination is NO exception normally. but we can consider a scoped compensating control for canary only: limit converter to non-user-input paths + runtime sandboxing.

sam: what about pinning to libproto@2.1.2 (previous patch) in the SBOM for this build? quick cherry-pick of the lockfile would keep the rest of the release intact.

mike: does pinning require a full rebuild and new image? how long?

sam: rebuild + smoke tests ~ 25-30m. we can still make the window if decision is immediate.

oliver: legal/compliance: we need a short rationale in release notes and we must record the exception if we bypass policy. pinning is preferable to exception.

judy: agree — pin + canary-only rollout seems safest. sigsec approves conditional pin and canary throttle, provided we add a runtime guard and an automatic roll-back if errors > 0.5% in 10m.

mike: ok. action plan: 1) sam do lockfile pin + rebuild (target +30m) 2) nina run quick smoke and staged QA 3) deploy-bot will lift hold after SBOM re-scan passes 4) set canary throttle to 5% and rollback threshold 0.5% errors. 5) oliver add legal note to release notes.

sam: starting pin now, creating branch `rc-2.3.0-pin-libproto-2.1.2` and draft changelog.

deploy-bot: build started for rc-2.3.0-pin-libproto-2.1.2 (job 3321). SBOM will re-run on completion.

nina: smoke tests queued. will report pass/fail in ~20m.

mike: if smoke green, I give go for canary with throttle. please @judy confirm once monitoring hooks are in.

judy: monitoring hooks added (traces + error alert). I'll be watching. :eyes:

sam: rebuild finished, SBOM rescan in progress.

deploy-bot: SBOM scan complete for job 3321: no vulnerabilities detected. HOLD released.

mike: canary deploy started at 16:35 PT -> 5% traffic. release notes updated with short security note.

nina: initial smoke good, canary metrics look clean at 10m.

judy: metrics still stable at 30m. no errors triggered. approving full rollout once canary hits 60m clean.

mike: thanks everyone — closing thread. will follow up in release notes with timeline and mitigation steps. :shipit:
